pinterest.title: 10 Rhodes Wedding Venues From Lindos to Rhodes Town
pinterest.description: Rhodes wedding venues sit in four parts of the island: Lindos and the south, Rhodes Town, the east coast around Kallithea and the west coast at Ixia. Our guide sets out nine of them on the same terms, from a boutique hotel below the Lindos acropolis to a 1927 landmark hotel in Rhodes Town. It is not a ranking, so you can compare setting, ceremony options and published capacity like for like.

pinterest.title: Lindos Wedding Venues: Village Hotel, Beach Resorts and St Paul's Chapel
pinterest.description: The south of Rhodes holds four wedding venues in our guide: Melenos in Lindos village, Aquagrand on Navarone Bay, Atrium Palace at Kalathos and Atrium Prestige in south Rhodes. Aquagrand and Atrium Palace both offer St Paul's Chapel below the Acropolis of Lindos as a ceremony option, and Atrium Prestige has a private chapel of its own, Tsambika, reached across a bridge.

pinterest.title: How to Compare Rhodes Wedding Venues Like for Like
pinterest.description: Every venue in our Rhodes wedding venues guide hosts weddings. Three questions then separate them: what kind of place it is, where the ceremony happens, and how many people it holds and houses. Only Grande Albergo delle Rose publishes a reception figure, seating up to 450 guests, so ask every venue about capacity, rooms and house rules in writing.

slides: Rhodes is on your shortlist. Here are 10 wedding venues from Lindos to Rhodes Town, set out on the same terms so you can compare them fairly.
Four parts of the island: Lindos and the south, Rhodes Town, the east coast around Kallithea and the west coast at Ixia. Choose an area before a venue.
Lindos and the south: Melenos in Lindos village, Aquagrand on Navarone Bay, Atrium Palace at Kalathos and Atrium Prestige, with its own chapel set in turquoise water.
Rhodes Town: Grande Albergo delle Rose, opened in 1927, seats receptions of up to 450 guests. Atrium Platinum sends couples to Kallithea Springs or Filerimos Hill for the ceremony.
The east coast: Kallithea Springs, a restored seaside monument with whitewashed columns and a dome that looks out to sea, and Elysium Resort & Spa for the reception.
The west coast: Rodos Palace in Ixia offers a large wedding ceremony and reception, a gathering with close family and friends, or a vibrant party.
Most venues do not publish guest capacity or room counts. Put capacity, rooms and house rules on your list of questions and ask every venue in writing.
Weighing up Rhodes venues? Send us your guest count and the venues on your list, and a Wedded Advisor will talk it through with you. Link in bio.
instagram_carousel.caption:
Planning a Rhodes wedding?

Our new guide sets out 10 Rhodes wedding venues across four parts of the island, each on the same terms: setting, ceremony options and published capacity. It is not a ranking. Where a venue does not state a detail, the guide says "not published".

Lindos and the south: Melenos, Aquagrand, Atrium Palace and Atrium Prestige.
Rhodes Town: Grande Albergo delle Rose and Atrium Platinum.
The east coast: Kallithea Springs and Elysium Resort & Spa.
The west coast: Rodos Palace in Ixia.

St Paul's Chapel below the Acropolis of Lindos is a ceremony option at both Aquagrand and Atrium Palace, and Atrium Palace advises booking it as early as possible. For a large reception, Grande Albergo delle Rose is the only venue here that publishes a figure, seating up to 450 guests.

Weighing up Rhodes venues? Send us a message with your guest count and the venues on your list. Your Wedded Advisor is one person, start to finish, and confirms inclusions in writing before you commit. Full guide at the link in our bio.
